18   motion, Senate adjourned.

 3                Motions and resolutions.

 4                Mr. Floor Leader.

 5                SENATOR DeFRANCISCO:   Can we turn 

 6   the mic up a little?  I barely can hear.  

 7                But I understand there's a 

 8   resolution at the desk by Senators Flanagan and 

 9   Klein.  May we please have it read in its 

10   entirety and move for its immediate adoption.

11                THE PRESIDENT:   The Secretary will 

12   read.

13                THE SECRETARY:   Concurrent 

14   Resolution Number 3323 of the Senate and 

15   Assembly, by Senators Flanagan and Klein, 

16   relative to the adjournment sine die of the 2017 

17   Session of the Legislature.

18                "RESOLVED, If the Assembly concur, 

19   that the 2017 Session of the Legislature adjourn 

20   sine die on Wednesday, January 3, 2018, 

21   simultaneously with the commencement of the 2018 

22   Legislative Session."

23                THE PRESIDENT:   The question is on 

24   the resolution.  All in favor signify by saying 

25   aye.


                                                                5902

 1                (Response of "Aye.")

 2                THE PRESIDENT:   Opposed?  

 3                (No response.)

 4                THE PRESIDENT:   The resolution is 

 5   adopted, and the 2017 session is now adjourned 

 6   sine die.

 7                (Whereupon, at 12:18 p.m., the 

 8   Senate adjourned.)
